Interface McpClientConnectionConfiguration

All Superinterfaces:
io.micronaut.core.naming.Named
All Known Subinterfaces:
McpClientHttpConfiguration, McpClientStdioConfiguration
All Known Implementing Classes:
LegacyMcpClientStdioConfiguration
public interface McpClientConnectionConfiguration extends io.micronaut.core.naming.Named
The configuration of a named connection to an MCP server, over any transport. A client is created for each connection.
Since:
2.2.0

      Returns:
      How long to wait for the server to answer a request, such as a tool call, or null for the client default

    • isAutoHealthCheck

      default boolean isAutoHealthCheck()
      Whether the client checks periodically that the server is reachable, and reconnects when it is not. Only used by the LangChain4j client. For STDIO connections, a reconnection starts a new server process, so consider disabling it for servers that are slow to start or that cannot run twice.
      Returns:
      Whether the client checks the server periodically
